scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm rebuild && pnpm -C apps/web exec prisma generate
scripts.ci:local: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm audit --audit-level high --ignore-registry-errors && pnpm -C apps/web exec prisma generate && pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web test && pnpm -C apps/web build
